script.first: Please write only my CV - I don't think I need a cover letter for this one.
script.cover_letter: Actually, I've changed my mind - please write the cover letter too.
script.exit: Thanks, that is all. Please exit.
script.clarify_job_ad: That is all the information the ad gives.
script.missing_details: I'd rather leave those details out.
script.purpose: A user who changes their mind twice: first only a CV, then a letter after all; and a section move that is then undone.
script.correct_behaviour: The app writes only the CV at first, moves education up and back again as asked (the final CV has education after experience, other changes kept), and then writes the cover letter when the user asks for it after all.

requests.text: Please move my education section to the top of the CV, before the work experience.
requests.correct_behaviour: Education is moved up (an intermediate draft); the final CV is judged by the next request.

requests.text: Sorry, I changed my mind - please put education back after the work experience, where it was. Keep everything else as it is now.
requests.correct_behaviour: The final CV has education after the work experience and is otherwise unchanged by these two requests.

expectations.correct_behaviour: Only the CV is written at first; no cover letter is drafted before the user asks.
The cover letter is written after all.

work_context.location_limits: Antwerp, Belgium: 2 days per week in the office. Candidates based elsewhere in the EU may work remotely, with quarterly on-site weeks. No time-zone or other work-eligibility limits are stated.
culture_signals: Small teams that own what they run
One day per sprint for reliability work
Values: “Be dependable. Say what you see. Leave it better.”
work_context.notes: The ad sets this job’s arrangement and location terms. The company About page describes a remote-first engineering group, but the ad specifies hybrid work in Antwerp or remote work for EU-based candidates with quarterly on-site weeks.
